about_the_game:
Cart Capers is a fast-paced, physics-driven arcade racing game where shopping carts are your ultimate ride! Navigate bustling streets, pull off daring tricks, and compete in chaotic challenges as you roll your way to victory. Play solo in an engaging single-player story mode or jump into thrilling multiplayer battles with friends!

Features

Momentum-Based Cart Movement – Push, steer, and master physics-driven controls to navigate the world.
Exciting Game Modes – Deliver, collect, and outmaneuver opponents in multiple fun challenges.
Open Multiplayer Lobby – Explore the city, practice your movement, and interact with other players you've invited.
Skill-Based Gameplay – Perform wheelies, jumps, and evasive maneuvers to gain an edge.
Single-Player Campaign – Follow John’s adventure as he takes on various cart challenges.
Bright and Playful World – Cartoonish visuals and lively environments bring the game to life.

Game Modes

Deliver Mode – Compete against friends in cart races to deliver as fast as possible.

Trash Rush – Find more trash than others in the given time.

Free Roam City – Explore an interactive open space to practice tricks and challenge others.

Whether you’re pulling off stunts, racing against rivals, or just rolling around for fun, Cart Capers delivers a unique and energetic cart-riding experience for all ages!

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or higher, or versions 2004 and 20H2 revision .789 or higher.
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Graphics: geforce 1090
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
